date_note: Date is the university's notice of 24 November as reported by Boannews; the intrusions are dated by the notice to 16 and 21 November.
title: Paichai University says the same attacker broke in again on 21 November; mail-account application data leaked
summary: Boannews reports that Paichai University, in a notice of 24 November, said the same attacker re-entered its academic and administrative server on 21 November through a path not blocked in the first response. Mail-account application data of 1만2050건 (the page's own figure) was confirmed leaked, per Boannews. The university had announced on 16 November that some personal data in its learning management system was leaked.
plain: A Korean university says the same attacker got in a second time and mail-account application data leaked, after an earlier leak from its learning system.
exec: Paichai University says a repeat intrusion by the same attacker leaked mail-account application data.

evidence.quote: 21일 재차 피해를 입은 해킹 공격으로는 메일 계정 신청 정보 1만2050건이 유출된 것으로 확인됐다.

validation.note: Only Boannews read; the university's own notice was not read. Boannews relays the university's 24 November notice.
